title: How is Saddam Hussein connected to Cookie Monster?
description:
Four real photos connect Iraq's Saddam Hussein to Cookie Monster from Sesame Street, through a defense secretary, a president and a first lady.

Saddam Hussein → Donald Rumsfeld → George W. Bush → Michelle Obama → Cookie Monster

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Saddam Hussein → Donald Rumsfeld: In 1983, Saddam Hussein shook hands with Donald Rumsfeld, sent to Baghdad as Reagan's special envoy.
   Photo by Iraqi state television, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Saddam_rumsfeld.jpg
2. Donald Rumsfeld → George W. Bush: In 2006, after leading the Pentagon through the Iraq War, Rumsfeld resigned as George W. Bush's defense secretary.
   Photo by White House photo by Paul Morse, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bush_and_Rumsfeld_shakes_hands,_November_8,_2006.jpg
3. George W. Bush → Michelle Obama: Days after the 2008 election, President Bush welcomed the Obamas to the White House.
   Photo by White House photo by Eric Draper, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bushes_with_Obamas_2.jpg
4. Michelle Obama → Cookie Monster: And in 2011, Michelle Obama posed on stage with Cookie Monster at an event for military families in Ohio.
   Photo by Elaine Sanchez, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jill_Biden_and_Michelle_Obama_pose_with_some_of_the_cast_of_Sesame_Street,_2011.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#saddamhussein #cookiemonster #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
